notablePrerequisites: Pyramid of the Pantheon does not have summoning sickness and has at least three brick counters on it.
description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Pyramid of the Pantheon to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
